body:
Subject: tag loss incident (fixed) — do not use aida edit --tags for batches

Heads-up: aida edit --tags REPLACES the tag set. Following the CLAUDE.md batch example I stripped every other tag (parent:EPIC-*, drain-safe, lanes) from 13 specs today (BUG-1222/1224/1226/1227/1229/1230/1233, SPIKE-82, STORY-1221, TASK-1271/1276/1278, TASK-1-140). All restored from store history as the union of old + batch tags; epic rollups should read right again. Filed BUG-1241 (guard the flag when it drops parent:*, doctor check, additive batch verb) and a docs PR switching every example to --add-tag. If you tagged waves the same way, the audit fingerprint is "tags after the commit are only batch:*"; I can run the audit over a wider window if you want.
